pr.title: {type}({KEY}): {description}
pr.reply_voice: English, short and plain, one or two lines

review.voice: lowercase, one or two short sentences, questions not prescriptions
taste: one rule in one place, never duplicated
a named helper over an inline block repeated twice
no comment that restates the code

deliver.merge: squash merge through the GitHub merge queue
rollout: Feature flag exists in every environment before the merge
Per-shop configuration created with its value for each shop
Migration reviewed before it reaches the shared staging database
deliver.release: deploy the merged commit to qa from the CI pipeline, then move the ticket to In QA
deliver.notes: staging is shared between teams: book it in #dev-shop before deploying a branch there.

traps: Each shop has its own settings row: a change reaches every shop unless a setting guards it.
The mobile app ships every two weeks: an API field it reads cannot be renamed in one release.
